product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides AI-powered eDiscovery, investigations, legal hold, and document-review software for corporate legal teams, law firms, legal service providers, government, and education.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage identifies the platform and its target organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no public pricing page; demo/contact-based sales path is provided instead.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in Reveal's customer success-story materials.

employee_band.notes: Reveal reports 500+ employees worldwide, which does not establish one of the requested bands exactly; LinkedIn's 501–1,000 band also exceeds the available choices.

hq_location.notes: Company lists its North American headquarters in Chicago, Illinois.

founded_year.notes: Reveal describes itself as serving the field since 2008; transaction profile says incorporated in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes multiple substantive product/technical implementation posts, including operationalizing AI agents and private deployment.

public_docs.notes: Support page links to multiple public product documentation libraries.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists open roles but none has AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision in its title.

model_provider.notes: Public materials surfaced product AI features and integrations but did not establish which model or provider Reveal's own product uses.

compliance_certs.notes: Reveal publicly claims ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 certifications.

last_funding.notes: The latest identified round was $200 million of growth equity announced January 26, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round dates to January 2021, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Account Executive, II and Accounts Executive I.

launched_6mo.notes: Reveal announced an Onna Claude connector on October 20, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Reveal announced a CEO transition from Wendell Jisa to Eric Harmon on October 14, 2025, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reveal's integrations page visibly names Salesforce.
